examples.en: We need helpers of all types, e.g., geologists and teachers.
examples.zh: 我们需要各种类型的协助者，例如地质学者和教师。

examples.en: Many people have the hobby of collecting things, e.g. stamps, postcards or antiques.
examples.zh: 许多人有收集东西的爱好，例如收集邮票、明信片或古董。

examples.en: They also looked at whether clothing items had childlike characteristics, e.g. polka dot patterns and ribbons.
examples.zh: 他们也会看衣服是否具有儿童般的特点，比如圆点花纹图案和丝带。
